_what: THE BREATHS of a long tone — HIS RULES (SW-18, his 'numbers good' 2026-11-09; RUNNING_LOG §122; journal D12). Read by tools/beat_saw.js (and every later tool that cuts a long tone into breaths). A 'held tone' is the sound between two inhalations; an 'inhalation' is the silence.
_ceilingS: how long a wind can hold at a dynamic, in seconds, by register (MIDI) — the morph's BREATH_TABLE (score/public/morph.js), an ESTIMATE from piece 5; his to correct per player. The dynamic column: p for marks under mp, mf for mp … mf, f for f and over.
_heldShare: the held tone as a share of the ceiling: 'as long as they can at a certain strength' — rolled evenly between the two
_short: one held tone in `shortEvery` is SHORT — a share of the ceiling rolled in `shortShare` — so no rhythm of breaths settles
_inhaleS: the inhalation, in seconds — 'a quick breath' (the morph's floor 0.40 is a snatch; 0.75 comfortable)
_bow: A STRING holds a long tone by the BOW, not the breath (2026-11-09, §123 — the AI's starts, his to correct): bowCeilingS how long one bow lasts at a dynamic, in seconds; bowChangeS the bow change's gap (near-seamless). The held share, the short-one rule and the ensemble gap apply as for a breath.
_crotale: A BOWED CROTALE (the sine moves, the bar holds): bowings of about targetS, never past ceilingS, gapS between — Approaching's beating section's numbers (its beat_pair.js BOW defaults), carried
_minLastS: a remainder under this is not a note — the tone before it takes the time
_ensembleMinGapS: across the ensemble no two players inhale within this many seconds of each other: the later one's tone is stretched or shortened inside its range to clear it (applied when a lane is cut beside others — tools/beat_saw.js --avoid)
